name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover a flooded bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover a flooded bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance coverage for a flooded bathroom depends on the cause of the flood and your specific policy. Generally, sudden and accidental water damage, like a burst pipe or overflowing toilet, is covered. However, damage from neglected maintenance, slow leaks, or external floods (like rising rivers) may not be covered or might require a separate flood insurance policy. It's essential to review your policy details or contact your insurance provider directly. A professional restoration company can often assist with documentation and communication with your insurer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coverage depends on the cause of the flood and your policy. Sudden damage is often covered, but check with your insurer.
